distractors.reason: 'Hardly' means 'barely' or 'almost not', so 'work hardly' suggests very little effort, the opposite of what is intended.
'Hardness' is a noun meaning the quality of being hard, so it cannot modify the verb 'work'.
'Harden' is a verb meaning to become firm or unyielding, so it cannot describe how someone works.

example_sentence: She had to work ___ all night to finish the report.
l1_interference: Носії української часто ставлять прислівник перед дієсловом, наприклад у фразі 'багато працювати' може з'явитися калька 'hard work' замість правильного 'work hard'.
explanation: In English, the adverb 'hard' follows the verb 'work' to describe how the action is done. 'Hardly' looks similar but has a negative meaning of barely doing something.

related_collocations.example: Please listen carefully to the instructions.
I did not sleep well last night.

memory_tip: WORK HARD = put in great effort | WORK HARDLY = hardly work at all (barely)
